# awsappstream_export_image_tasks (Data Source)

Reads multiple AppStream export image tasks for the current AWS account and region. This data source can be used to monitor the status of export operations, list completed or failed tasks, and inspect metadata such as created time, resulting AMI IDs, and error details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# minimal export image tasks
data "awsappstream_export_image_tasks" "example" {}
```

```terraform
# export image tasks filtered by image ARN
data "awsappstream_export_image_tasks" "example" {
  filters = [{
    name   = "image-arn"
    values = ["my-image"]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Optional filters to narrow down the list of export image tasks. Filters allow selecting tasks by attributes such as state or creation date. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `export_image_tasks` (Attributes Set) The list of export image tasks that match the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--export_image_tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the filter to apply.
- `values` (Set of String) One or more values for the specified filter name.


<a id="nestedatt--export_image_tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `export_image_tasks`

Read-Only:

- `ami_description` (String) The description applied to the exported EC2 AMI, if set.
- `ami_id` (String) The ID of the EC2 AMI created by the export image task. This attribute is only populated when the task completes successfully.
- `ami_name` (String) The name of the EC2 AMI created by the export image task.
- `created_date` (String) The timestamp when the export image task was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `error_details` (Attributes Set) Details about errors that occurred during the export process. This attribute is only populated when the task state is `FAILED`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--export_image_tasks--error_details))
- `image_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AppStream Applications image being exported.
- `state` (String) The current state of the export image task. Valid values are `EXPORTING`, `COMPLETED`, or `FAILED`.
- `tag_specifications` (Map of String) The tags applied to the exported EC2 AMI.
- `task_id` (String) The unique identifier of the export image task.

<a id="nestedatt--export_image_tasks--error_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `export_image_tasks.error_details`

Read-Only:

- `error_code` (String) The error code reported by AWS.
- `error_message` (String) The human-readable error message reported by AWS.
